question: Should this PR's default `sessions_search` agent tool and `operator.read` `sessions.search` Gateway method be accepted as the core transcript-search boundary for the protected feature issue?
rationale: The PR exposes searchable transcript-content snippets and a persistent transcript index, so automation cannot choose the final access and redaction boundary without maintainer security/product intent.

options.title: Approve Core Search After Repair
options.body: Accept the tool and Gateway method after the catalog/policy defect is fixed and maintainer security review confirms the scope.

options.title: Narrow The Boundary
options.body: Require a tighter scope, caller policy, or target restriction before exposing transcript-content search through Gateway and agent tools.

options.title: Defer The Surface
options.body: Keep the linked feature issue open and do not land this default core search API until the product direction is sponsored.

recommendation.title: Approve Core Search After Repair
recommendation.body: Accept the tool and Gateway method after the catalog/policy defect is fixed and maintainer security review confirms the scope.

likelyOwner.reason: They opened the protected canonical feature issue and were directly asked to confirm the exact v1 security/product boundary.
